copy.tagline: 遵循 React 和 JSX 开发标准，提升代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 React 和 JSX 开发，需要统一编码标准
copy.tagline_en: Follow React and JSX development standards to improve code quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop with React and JSX and need consistent coding standards

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 React 和 JSX 的最佳实践来编写代码，只使用函数组件和 Hooks，并自动应用 Prettier 和 ESLint 规则。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或修改 React/JSX 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 函数组件，展示用户列表。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 JSX 标准的组件。

say.text: 检查这段 JSX 代码的 Hooks 使用是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会验证 Hooks 规则。

say.text: 重构这个类组件为函数组件。
say.note: Claude 会移除类组件，改用 Hooks。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will write code following React and JSX best practices, using only functional components and hooks, and automatically applying Prettier and ESLint rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or modify React/JSX code.

say_en.text: Write a React functional component that displays a list of users.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a component compliant with JSX standards.

say_en.text: Check if the hooks usage in this JSX code is correct.
say_en.note: Claude will verify the Rules of Hooks.

say_en.text: Refactor this class component into a functional component.
say_en.note: Claude will remove class components and use hooks instead.
